case.title: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH. Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor. Need: 30000 kits a year. Category goal: routine: fewer suppliers and less process cost. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 5 days). Fallback if you walk away: today's terms continue unchanged. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70610.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

It is always a pleasure to work with you, and we are delighted to present our proposal for your component requirements. As a reliable supply partner, we pride ourselves on delivering excellent service and maintaining a comprehensive product range to keep your production running smoothly. 

For the requested volume, we can offer you a price of €5.74 per unit. This quote comes with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We trust this proposal meets your expectations and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship. Please do not hesitate to reach out if you have any questions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

move.subject: Re: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
move.body:
Dear Franz Stadler,

thank you for your offer and for the reliable cooperation. We would like to settle this in a way that works for both sides. We can commit for the longer term, which gives you planning security: 36 months. Our forecast fc:360011@2026-09 expects 208,400 units a year, a change of +15.3 %. On that basis we propose EUR 4.82 per unit, payment 90 days net, a 36-month contract.

Best regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

Thank you for your positive response; we welcome the 36-month commitment and have factored the verified volume increase into our pricing. Extending payment terms to 90 days is outside our standard commercial framework, so we must maintain 30 days net. 

Our current offer features a price of €5.58 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: a price of €5.51 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 36 months.

A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

Thank you for your revised proposal and your willingness to move towards us. We always appreciate our relationship and the opportunity to support your requirements with our reliable service and broad product range. 

In response to your adjustment, we can offer a further reduced price of €5.41 per unit for the 36-month contract with 90-day payment terms.
